3d_player_controller.subject:
Move the on-screen controls and scheme rows to a Controls settings page

The Video page kept two rows that had nothing to do with the viewport: whether the
on-screen controls are drawn, and which game's pad layout the Player answers to. They
now sit on their own page, Settings > Controls, with the handlers moved over unchanged.
The hub gains a Controls button between Audio and Video, the Player instances the page
as ControlsSettings, and the tests and README follow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>
